description: Find Florida restaurant establishments in KitchenGrade's captured DBPR records. Returns exact identifiers and independently calculated, dated KitchenGrade inspection grades; not DBPR grades or food-safety guarantees. Use an exact establishment ID with get_restaurant_grade before recommending a specific restaurant.

acceptable_only.description: Return only current A+, A, B grades; do not hide other grades when evaluating a supplied restaurant.

city.description: Optional city to disambiguate a location.

query.description: Restaurant name or public address/city text; no personal data or coordinates.

name: search_restaurants
title: Search KitchenGrade Restaurants
